title: Bill Hadnot tells him Jay McShann is forming a band
summary: Bassist Bill Hadnot tells him Jay is forming a band at Martin's on the Plaza, and letters bring Gus back in 1937-38.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: I saw a friend of mine. His name is Bill Hadnot. He's a bass player.
Sure, and he told me about --
He worked with T-Bone quite a lot. He made a lot of those records with T-Bone.
Yeah. Well, that's a good bass player.
The last time I heard him in L.A. he was playing with Nelly Lutcher. And that was about two years ago.
Well, maybe he was. And he was still working for Douglas Aircraft, he's --
See, we've been friends a long time.
Isn't that nice? I'll tell him because I'll see him soon. I'll tell him what you told me.
I always call him up when I'm there.
And go to the house and have dinner or something.
Yeah, that's nice, that's very nice. Well, so he told you.
Yeah, he told me about Jay starting the band.
Well, did you know who Jay was?
No, I didn't know Jay. I didn't know him. He said he was from Oklahoma, and he would send me a letter and let me know if -- because he was going to join Jay himself, see.
But he didn't join Jay when I was -- when I joined Jay.
See, he had made some gigs with Jay
And he was talking about forming this band.
Yeah. Gus, what year would this be, do you think?
That should be around about '36 or '37 when this happened.
Then joined Jay McShann in Kansas City in '38.
But he told me about this in '37.
And so, I said, 'Yeah, if he's going to start a band and you're in it, sure, I'll come up there.'
Come back to Kansas City. So they sent for me to come to Kansas City.
